newsitem.title: GREECE: ATHLETICS-PROFILE OF WORLD POLE VAULT CHAMPION BUBKA.
newsitem.headline: ATHLETICS-PROFILE OF WORLD POLE VAULT CHAMPION BUBKA.

text.p: Profile of Sergei Bubka, who won the world pole vault title on Sunday.
Only athlete to have won a title at all six world championships.
Has set 17 world outdoor records since 1984 including the first vault of six metres in 1985. Current record of 6.14 was set in 1994 in Sestriere, Italy.

The 1988 Olympic champion, he failed to clear a height in 1992 in Barcelona and did not start last year's Olympics in Atlanta after suffering an Achille tendon injury while warming up for the qualifying round.
